messages:
ria: Quick flag from today

We saw a recurring off-by-one-year pattern from the low-precision cascade on a factual date eval. Not noise, looks deterministic across shadow runs.

omar: can you dump one pair and the profile used? also include whether per-layer clipping was enabled.

ria: sample (redacted):
Q: 'When was NovaTech incorporated?'
lowp: 'Sep 9, 2016'
fp16: 'Sep 9, 2017'
profile: cascade-int8-4bit-2024-12, clip=true, scaleset=v4

lee: my guess is rounding bias from asymmetric quant scales plus a narrow clip on a few attention heads. run head activation diffs and token topk deltas.

ria: kicking off replay with logits/topk and head stats. replay id r-20241209-01.

deploy-bot: replay started (r-20241209-01). ETA 6m.

omar: operational mitigations: hold canary for that profile; prepare a per-head scale override (hotpatch) and a CI regression that checks date prompts for mean token shift < 0.15 tokens.

lee: if it's just a couple heads we can patch runtime to apply a tiny additive offset (directional clamp) on those heads post-quant. longer term: tighten profile validation to catch mean drift.

ria: holding rollouts, adding tickets: ML-rt/382 (per-head-clamp), CI-quant/91 (date-regress). will post replay artifacts when done.

deploy-bot: replay completed. artifacts: /mnt/replays/r-20241209-01/.

omar: thanks. lee, can you take the bisect tomorrow? if you find a minimal head set we test hotpatch on shadow before any rollback.

ria: will follow up with the artifact links and quick summary for CS if needed.
